about: P45B T11: 25 dev sentences where a course (stages, countdown, waves) makes sense, for recording local gpt-oss-20b director answers with logic. Never test-200, held-out or sealed sets.
rule: Axes in this order with quotas defend 3, rescue 3, defeat 4, survive 4, escape 4, race 4, collect 3. Within an axis the first sentences in set order (p30/dev.json, p37a/dev-150.json, p41/sentences.json groups single, multi-action, paraphrase), file order inside a set, never a sentence picked by an earlier axis. survive/escape/race/collect = extractIntent objective; defend = words defend(s)/protect(s); rescue = rescue(s)/save(s); defeat = fight(s|ing)/defeat(s)/battle(s)/slay(s).
